Positions use measured text dimensions, with at least 18 columns between diagram columns and seven rows between vertically adjacent peripherals. All edge references are 1-based raw lines.

Source-grounded corrections and qualifications: (1) Projection maps live per instance. apiProjection.ts:10 states an intention to share one backend instance, but sessionService.ts:70 and liveCanvasService.ts:36 independently default to new instances; supplied construction wiring does not establish sharing. (2) Diagram-context status depends on binding and source fingerprint, while materialization supplies the payload separately (sessionService.ts:241-249). Thus the seed overstates materialized backing data as a prerequisite for status. (3) The checkpoint save flow applies without nodeId; saving one diagram instead isolates a versioned snapshot, rebases metadata and saves without canvas edges (sessionService.ts:672-714). (4) QuickJS context lifetime is one runtime invocation, including a fresh invocation during replay; retained retry state belongs to the session service. Pure-read request-cache release specifically requires a result with version and without transaction (sessionService.ts:186-188).

for e in x['finalCanvas']['edges']: print(e)
